configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: Catalogue categories, geographic areas and quality standards applied to suppliers.

category.description: Set up how products or services are classified.

subCategory.description: Link the subcategory to an existing category.

country.description: Set the country's code, currency and dialling code.

city.description: Link the city to a configured country.
city.coordinatesHint: Used by the “Near me” search for sellers in the city who have not entered their head office.

deleteDialog.title: Confirm deletion
deleteDialog.description: “{label}” will be permanently deleted. This may fail if the item is still in use.

quality.title: Supplier quality standards
quality.description: Thresholds applied to each supplier to calculate their compliance score.
quality.saved: Standards saved. Scores are recalculated the next time they are viewed.

minResponseRate.label: Minimum response rate
minResponseRate.hint: Customer conversations with at least one reply.

minStockPerProduct.label: Minimum stock per product
minStockPerProduct.hint: Each published product must have at least this many.

evaluationWindowDays.label: Evaluation window
evaluationWindowDays.hint: Period over which the indicators are calculated.

content.title: Content
content.description: Help pages, FAQ, terms of use and footer of the website and the app.

pageEditor.saved: {locale, select, fr {French content saved.} en {English content saved.} pt {Portuguese content saved.} ar {Arabic content saved.} other {Content saved.}}
pageEditor.missingTranslation: {locale, select, en {No English version yet: visitors see the French version.} pt {No Portuguese version yet: visitors see the French version.} ar {No Arabic version yet: visitors see the French version.} other {No version yet: visitors see the French version.}}
pageEditor.title: Title
pageEditor.bodyHint: “## Title” starts a section, “- ” a list item; a blank line separates paragraphs. You can paste an entire text.

siteSettings.offlineHint: Shown to buyers who choose “Transfer or deposit”: bank, account holder, IBAN / bank details, reference to include. Leave empty to remove this payment option.
siteSettings.columnsHint: One column per block (separated by a blank line): the title on the first line, then one link per line “Label | /address”.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Details of the administrator account currently signed in.

compliance.runDone: Check complete: {raised, plural, one {# new issue} other {# new issues}}, {closed, plural, one {# resolved} other {# resolved}}, {reminders, plural, one {# reminder} other {# reminders}}.
compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.description: Supplier documents, banned terms and audit log. Automatic check every morning.
compliance.descriptionLastRun: Supplier documents, banned terms and audit log. Automatic check every morning (last: {date}).

audit.title: Audit log ({count})
audit.description: Who did what, when and from where: financial actions, moderation, catalogue, settings. Click a row to see the values before and after. Exports are limited to 10,000 rows and are themselves logged.

documents.rejectReason: Reason for rejection (sent to the supplier)

findings.dismissPrompt: Why dismiss this issue? (kept in the log)

terms.title: Banned terms ({count})
terms.description: Matched as whole words in listing titles and descriptions, ignoring case and accents (“arm” does not match “charm”). “Rejected” prevents saving; “Monitor” lets it through and flags the listing to the team. The morning check also scans listings already online.
